claims: McDonald's Hunter Sauce is a limited-time sweet chili dipping sauce.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce was introduced on March 31, 2026.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce was introduced as part of the "KPop Demon Hunters" meal collaboration.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce features a blend of chili, garlic, and pepper.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce offers a sweet and tangy flavor with mild heat.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce is often described as similar to a sweet-and-sour sauce.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce has a sweet, tangy, and slightly spicy flavor profile with notes of garlic and pepper.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce was released with the HUNTR/X Meal.
The HUNTR/X Meal consists of 10-piece McNuggets.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce was released with the Saja Boys Meal.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce pairs with Chicken McNuggets.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce pairs with Ramyeon McShaker Fries.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce was launched alongside a purple "Demon Sauce".
McDonald's Hunter Sauce was launched as part of a tie-in with the "KPop Demon Hunters" Netflix film.
McDonald's Hunter Sauce is available for a limited time at participating locations while supplies last.
